recentItems.title: Why ‘salt finger mixing’ draws Rutgers scientists to warming ocean
recentItems.description:
A thousand miles east of Barbados, in the tropical North Atlantic, two Rutgers University oceanographers are leading a 25-day expedition to study a process called salt finger mixing — and whether it can keep nutrients flowing as the planet, and the seas, warms. What they find may matter for the marine food chain.

recentItems.title: Latest on voter registration error, Delaney Hall, NJ’s top headlines | Reporters Roundtable
recentItems.description:
On Reporters Roundtable, Joanna Gagis talks with a panel of reporters -- Colleen O’Dea with NJ Spotlight News, Jelani Gibson with NJ.com and P. Kenneth Burns with WHYY -- about the latest news out of New Jersey this week.

Lt. Gov. Dale Caldwell, who also serves as Secretary of State, will cooperate with House Republicans' request for records on the state's voter registration error.

The panel of reporters also discusses the latest on the Delaney Hall immigrant detention center and more.
